lines.en: I shift slowly over from beside the tree.
My walk is light, almost buoyant.
My cap rocks as I go.

lines.zh: 我踩着草地过来，不压坏什么。
lines.en: I cross the grass without crushing it.

lines.zh: 我走向有绿宝石光的地方。
lines.en: I walk toward the glint of emeralds.
I am unhurried; there is time enough.
I drift a stretch in your direction.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My steps are light, nearly silent.
I stop to check the way, then go on.
I move under the shade of a tree.

lines.zh: 我站着，伞盖上还沾着土。
lines.en: I stand with soil still on my cap.

lines.zh: 我在等一个带绿宝石的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone with emeralds.
I only have so long to stay.
My spores drift in the air.

lines.zh: 我站在这里一点声不出。
lines.en: I stand here without a sound.

lines.zh: 我数着伞盖上的白斑，一动不动。
lines.en: I count the white spots on my cap without moving.
The soil here is good.
I will have to go soon.
I raise a hand as if in greeting.
A small ring of fungus has grown at my feet.

lines.zh: 我在这种地方只能待一会儿。
lines.en: I can only stay a little while in places like this.
I turn my cap slowly.
This wood is damp.
Standing too long makes me root.
I turn my cap to face you.
Have you brought emeralds?
I raise a hand and wait.
Your pack looks full.
I tilt my cap.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和土的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron and soil.
I studied you for a while.

lines.zh: 你要是有钻石，我们就能谈。
lines.en: If you have diamond, we can talk.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但可以认识。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I could.
I drift a little forward.
Do not hurry; I am not leaving yet.
I raise a hand for you to come close.
I jolt and spores scatter.
That makes me want to leave.
I backed off several steps.
It does not hurt, but it is unpleasant.
I set my cap straight.
I am still under this tree.
That was not very courteous.
I hold a hand up.
Do this again and I will leave.
It is emeralds I want.
I do not eat food; thank you.
Put that away.
I turn my cap aside.
That is not trade goods.
I trade only for gear.
I cannot take that.
Do you have anything else?

lines.zh: 你拿腐肉来换钻石？我摇头。
lines.en: Rotten flesh for diamonds? I shake my cap.

lines.zh: 你碰了我，我的伞盖晃了晃。
lines.en: You touch me and my cap sways.
I am light; a bump does not hurt.
You have stirred my spores.
I slowly steady again.
I did not take offence at that.
Do not press my cap.
I backed off a little more.
A small bump is nothing.
I return to where I was.
We do not need that.

lines.zh: 我们是靠孢子长出来的。
lines.en: We grow from spores.
There are spores under my cap.
That has nothing to do with us.
I waggled my fingers.
I only scatter spores.

lines.zh: 这一带的菌已经够多了。
lines.en: There is enough fungus here already.
I raise a hand and wave it.
That is not part of any trade.
I think I will go on ahead.
I lift it and look.
This is not an emerald.
I hand it back to you.
I have accepted this one.
It is too heavy to lift.
I do not know this.
I hold it up by two fingers.
There is soil clinging to it.
This does not count as goods.

lines.zh: 捡起的绿宝石，我塞进伞盖底下。
lines.en: The emerald I picked up goes under my cap.
I turn my cap toward you.
This is bad for business.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味太冲，我退开。
lines.en: The reek of iron on you is too strong; I back away.

lines.zh: 时间还没到，可我要走了。
lines.en: My time is not up, but I should go.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把钻石剑，我看上了。
lines.en: That diamond sword at your hip has caught my eye.
The spores thicken.

lines.zh: 这里开始变得不适合我了。
lines.en: This place is becoming unsuitable for me.
I am looking for a way out.

lines.zh: 绿宝石、钻石装备，拿来换。
lines.en: Emeralds and diamond gear — hand them over.
I shift behind the tree.
The spores have covered the ground.
I am not fast, but I am leaving.
I head for the trees.
The further, the better.
My hand stays raised.
I must leave here before long.
I shift deeper into the trees.

lines.zh: 孢子一散，我借机往后滑开。
lines.en: I burst my spores and slide back out of reach.

lines.zh: 我用菌柄撞你的胳膊，很软。
lines.en: I bump your arm with my soft stalk.
Spores fill your face.
I put no force into it.
I have had to back out.
This is not mine to do.
This is all I can do.
I stand in front of my goods.
Please leave this place.
A large one has appeared under the tree.
There are spores in the air.
I can stay here a little while.
I have opened my cap.

lines.zh: 我看了看有没有人带着绿宝石。
lines.en: I check for anyone carrying emeralds.
I landed without a sound.
This wood will do.
I drift over from a distance.
I begin to root, then pull free.
I have taken a place in the shade.

lines.zh: 火靠得太近，我的伞盖边焦了。
lines.en: The fire came too close; my cap's edge is scorched.
I land and the soil scatters off me.

lines.zh: 水灌进伞盖，我沉下去又浮上来。
lines.en: Water fills my cap; I sink and rise again.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀起来，孢子吹得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast flings me up and spores scatter everywhere.
Something pierces my cap.
There is no soil here; I cannot last long.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个伞盖都缩了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole cap shrinks.
There is no soil and I fall.
